sponsored.t: Permanently authorizes the pilot residential parking permit system in the city of Buffalo
sponsored.sum: Permanently authorizes the pilot residential parking permit system in the city of Buffalo.

sponsored.t: Provides for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions providing for the sale of municipal obligations by the county of Erie.

sponsored.t: Relates to the staffing and operations of a cancer research institute and a related not-for-profit corporation
sponsored.sum: Transfers the Buffalo Division of Health Research, Inc. to the Roswell Park Cancer Research Corporation.

sponsored.t: Adds the Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad scenic byway into the state scenic byways system
sponsored.sum: Adds the Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad scenic byway into the state scenic byways system.

sponsored.t: Relinquishes certain criminal and police jurisdiction over members of the Seneca Nation of Indians and recognizing the sovereign authority of the Seneca Nation over matters occurring within its territories
sponsored.sum: Relinquishes certain criminal and police jurisdiction over members of the Seneca Nation of Indians; recognizes the sovereign authority of the Seneca Nation over matters occurring within its territories.

sponsored.t: Provides that certain purchase contracts to purchase food can be awarded to a qualified bidder who complies with certain standards when such bid is not more than 10% higher than the lowest responsible bidder
sponsored.sum: Provides that certain purchase contracts to purchase food can be awarded to a qualified bidder who fulfills certain values based procurement standards when such bid is not more than 10% higher than the lowest responsible bidder and when the bidder makes publicly available data on where such bidder sources their food items; sets forth the criteria for values based procurement standards to include local economies, environmental resilience, racial equity, valued workforce, valued agricultural sector, animal welfare, and nutrition.

sponsored.t: Relates to registrations of residential mortgages in default
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Increases fee amount authorized to be imposed on mortgagees or their agents.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting prohibitions of advertising of cannabis products or services on billboards
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for advertising of cannabis licensees, products or services on billboards; limits information that may appear on billboards; prohibits billboard advertising by a cannabis licensee is a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Facilitates the marketing of any issue of serial bonds or notes of the city of Buffalo issued on or before a certain date
sponsored.sum: Facilitates the marketing of any issue of serial bonds or notes of the city of Buffalo issued on or before June 30, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to adult-use retail dispensary naming rights agreements
sponsored.sum: Limits an adult-use retail dispensary licensee to no more than five adult-use retail dispensary naming rights agreements.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the widow of William James Middlebrooks to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Janice Middlebrooks, the widow of William James Middlebrooks, to file a retirement option election on behalf of her deceased husband.

sponsored.t: Relates to enforcement actions by the office of cannabis management
sponsored.sum: Expands available enforcement actions by the office of cannabis management.

sponsored.t: Relates to commissaries and canteens at correctional institutions
sponsored.sum: Relates to commissaries and canteens at correctional institutions; provides that items for sale at a commissary or canteen shall be sold for no more than a certain percentage over the purchase price; provides that the department of corrections and community supervisions shall publish on its website the price list for all commissary items for sale at each institution as of June 1, 2026 and on an annual basis thereafter.

sponsored.t: Relates to school potable water testing, and standards and requirements to install filtered water stations and faucets
sponsored.sum: Relates to school potable water testing, and standards and requirements to install filtered water stations and faucets.

sponsored.t: Provides tax abatement related to the removal of leaded paint
sponsored.sum: Provides tax abatement related to the removal of lead-based paint; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Creates an office to residential conversion tax credit and a historic preservation rehabilitation office to residential conversion tax credit
sponsored.sum: Creates an office to residential conversion tax credit which shall be administered by the empire state development corporation; creates a historic preservation rehabilitation office to residential conversion tax credit which shall be administered by the state historic preservation office.

sponsored.t: Relates to the entering of lands owned or occupied by any nation, tribe, or band of Indians by a person and to law enforcement agreements with the Seneca nation
sponsored.sum: Provides that a person shall not be deemed to have entered the lands owned or occupied by a nation, tribe, or band of Indians if such person is temporarily and continuously passing through such lands; provides that at the request of the Seneca nation, the superintendent of state police, a sheriff of a county that includes lands of the Seneca nation, or the chief of police of the city of Salamanca may enter into an agreement with the Seneca nation detailing the activities such law enforcement entity will undertake within the nation's federally-recognized Indian Country lands; provides that such agreements shall not be construed to limit powers, duties, and responsibilities to undertake…

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain licensed health service professionals to form limited liability companies
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain licensed health service professionals to form limited liability companies.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the city of Buffalo to adopt a local law requiring police officers in such city to be residents of Buffalo
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Buffalo to adopt a local law requiring a member of the police force in such city to be a resident of Buffalo subsequent to the effective date of such local law.

sponsored.t: Creates the lupus research enhancement program and the lupus research enhancement fund
sponsored.sum: Creates the lupus research enhancement program; creates the lupus research enhancement fund.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination in the issuance of certain insurance policies based upon inquiries in which loss or damage is revealed
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination in the issuance of certain insurance policies based upon inquiries in which loss or damage is revealed.

sponsored.t: Prohibits motor vehicle insurers from discrimination on the basis of socioeconomic factors in determining algorithms used to construct actuarial tables, coverage terms, premiums and/or rates
sponsored.sum: Prohibits motor vehicle insurers from discrimination on the basis of socioeconomic factors in determining algorithms used to construct actuarial tables, coverage terms, premiums and/or rates.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a hotel and motel tax in the city of Buffalo
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a hotel and motel tax in the city of Buffalo, in the county of Erie.

sponsored.t: Provides for a review of rating territory definitions for non-business automobile insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Establishes as a distinct territory for purposes of rating private passenger nonbusiness automobile insurance policies, a certain city with a population between 19,040 and 25,000 which is geographically contiguous to a city with a population between 292,648 and 350,000; provides that the superintendent may require insurers to adjust existing or establish new territory definitions based on such review.

sponsored.t: Provides an asbestos remediation tax credit
sponsored.sum: Provides an asbestos remediation tax credit in Erie county; allows for a fifty percent credit of all eligible costs which are incurred as a result of asbestos remediation, not to exceed $1,000,000.

sponsored.t: Relates to apportionment for charter school tuition payments
sponsored.sum: Provides for apportionment for charter school tuition payments for any school district that is required to pay tuition to charter schools in the two thousand twenty-five-two thousand twenty-six school year and thereafter.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions or practices that establish or maintain a monopoly, monopsony or restraint of trade, and authorizes a class action lawsuit in the state anti-trust law
sponsored.sum: Relates to actions or practices that establish or maintain a monopoly, monopsony or restraint of trade; authorizes a class action lawsuit in the state anti-trust law.

sponsored.t: Establishes a health care disparities data collection system
sponsored.sum: Establishes a health care disparities data collection system.

sponsored.t: Establishes environmental standards for ambient lead and lead contamination
sponsored.sum: Establishes environmental standards for ambient lead and lead contamination in soils and on floors and window sills.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance coverage for medical marijuana
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing insurance coverage for medical marihuana.

sponsored.t: Repeals the excise tax on medical cannabis and the medical cannabis trust fund
sponsored.sum: Repeals the excise tax on medical cannabis and the medical cannabis trust fund.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the approval of a charter school application when such school would operate within the Buffalo city school district
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the approval of a charter school application when such school would operate within the Buffalo city school district.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state justice reinvestment fund and program to provide not-for-profit and faith based entities with funding to improve certain communities; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state justice reinvestment fund and program to provide not-for-profit and faith based entities with funding to improve communities with a higher than normal criminal offender and ex-offender population; appropriates $10,000,000 therefor.

sponsored.t: Requires teachers employed by the Buffalo school district to reside within Buffalo city limits
sponsored.sum: Requires teachers employed by the Buffalo school district to reside within Buffalo city limits.

sponsored.t: Establishes the block by block homeownership program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the block by block homeownership program to provide capital subsidies for the purpose of constructing, preserving, and rehabilitating one- to two- family dwellings throughout the state, outside of NYC.

sponsored.t: Makes provisions regarding appointment of members of the board of education for the city of Buffalo
sponsored.sum: Increases from 9 to 11 the number of members on the board of education for the city school district of Buffalo; provides for appointment of two members by the Mayor of the city of Buffalo.

sponsored.t: Requires colleges and universities to provide all incoming and current students with information relating to suicide prevention and resources
sponsored.sum: Requires public and private colleges and universities to provide all incoming and current students with information relating to suicide prevention and resources available to them on campus.

sponsored.t: Establishes a temporary state commission to conduct a feasibility study on the formation and control of a state public bank
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary state commission to conduct a feasibility study to evaluate and make recommendations concerning the formation and control of a state public bank; provides if such study finds that the state bank is feasible, the commission may recommend legislation to create a state public bank for New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the financing of charter schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to the financing of charter schools and apportionments.

sponsored.t: Relates to asset forfeiture
sponsored.sum: Relates to asset forfeiture.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of health to establish demonstration projects providing for equity investment in the operation of residential health care facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to establish demonstration projects providing for equity investment in the operation of residential health care facilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes business franchise and personal income tax credits for a portion of the consideration paid under a contract with a minority or women-owned business
sponsored.sum: Establishes business franchise and personal income tax credits for a portion of the consideration paid under a contract with a minority or women-owned business.

sponsored.t: Allows an action for unlawful discriminatory practice to be brought within three years after dismissal for administrative convenience
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the institution of a suit in any court of competent jurisdiction alleging a violation of the human rights law for a period of three years after the dismissal of a complaint for administrative convenience by the division of human rights.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for the release of certain grand jury proceeding materials on the basis of enduring historical importance
sponsored.sum: Allows a person to petition the court for grand jury proceeding materials on the basis of enduring historical importance.

sponsored.t: Requires the board of education in the city of Buffalo to submit the school district budget to the voters for approval prior to adoption
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of education in the city of Buffalo to submit the school district budget to the voters for approval prior to adoption.

sponsored.t: Establishes a Center for Transplantation and Immunology Research at the University at Buffalo and Erie County Medical Center; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Center for Transplantation and Immunology Research at the University at Buffalo and Erie County Medical Center; provides the mission of the Center for Transportation and Immunology Research is to advance the longevity of kidney organ transplants through improved knowledge of immunology, pathology and therapeutics; grants authorization to apply for grants; makes an appropriation of $227,333.34 each year for three years.

sponsored.t: Establishes the city of Buffalo parking authority
sponsored.sum: Establishes the city of Buffalo parking authority; provides for its powers, duties and obligations.

sponsored.t: Relates to recertification for paratransit
sponsored.sum: Allows individuals to use correspondence from a licensed physician, dated within the preceding thirty days, indicating that paratransit service is necessary for such individual, in place of in-person recertification.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for paratransit services
sponsored.sum: Opens eligibility of paratransit services to individuals with disabilities or health conditions who are able to utilize the public buses and railroad operated by the authority.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the application of topical fluoride varnish to a child's teeth by a parent or legal guardian
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the application of topical fluoride varnish to a child's teeth by a parent or legal guardian provided that such application is done under the direction and supervision of a licensed practitioner.

sponsored.t: Prohibits regional off-track betting corporations from providing items of value exceeding fifteen dollars to certain associates of the corporation
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits regional off-track betting corporations from providing items of value exceeding fifteen dollars to any board member, officer, or employee of the corporation, any contractor, subcontractor, consultant, or other agent of the corporation, or any spouse, child, sibling or parent of such persons; adds reporting requirements for regional off-track betting corporations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits off-track betting corporation vehicles from being used as take-home vehicles
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits off-track betting corporation vehicles from being used as take-home vehicles by board members, officers, employees, contractors, subcontractors, consultants, or agents of such corporation or by certain family members of such individuals; provides an exception therefor.

sponsored.t: Provides alternative retirement benefits for the police force at Erie County Medical Center
sponsored.sum: Provides alternative retirement benefits for the police force at Erie County Medical Center; provides a qualifying member shall receive a retirement allowance consisting of a pension equal to one-fiftieth of their final average salary for each year of qualifying creditable service.

sponsored.sum: Relates to intrusions upon lands owned or occupied by any nation, tribe or band of Indians, and to drug trafficking activities within Indian lands; provides that the district attorney of a county in which reservation lands are situated, upon application of a person designated by the laws of a nation, tribe or band to make such application, shall make complaint of intrusions on such lands and cause intruders to be removed; provides that the governor, the superintendent of state police, a sheriff of a county that includes lands of the Seneca nation, or the chief of police of the city of Salamanca, may, at the request of the Seneca nation, enter into an agreement with the Seneca nation…

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 46 Chapter 665 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 8289, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the Indian law, in relation to non-Indian trespass and drug trafficking activities within Indian lands" APPROVED This bill expands the ability of Indian nations to identify and expel intruders from Indian land. The bill would also allow the Seneca Nation to enter into agreements with law enforcement entities to enhance public safety on Seneca Nation land. The Seneca Nation has indicated that this bill is necessary for the safety and wellbeing of the Seneca people. Other Indian tribes, seeking to enhance public safety on their lands, also have indicated support for this bill. However, some ambiguities and technical issues in the bill needed to be clarified, including concerning the nature of agreements between the Seneca Nation and local law enforcement. sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory health insurance coverage for follow-up screening or diagnostic services for lung cancer
sponsored.sum: Requires that health insurance policies shall provide coverage for follow-up screening or diagnostic services for lung cancer; provides that no patient cost sharing shall be imposed for follow-up screening or diagnostic services for lung cancer.

sponsored.t: Reforms the education requirements for persons who want to become certified public accountants
sponsored.sum: Reforms the education requirements for persons who want to become certified public accountants; provides alternative pathways to being certified as certified public accountants.

sponsored.t: Removes the prohibition on patient participation in multiple transplant programs in New York state
sponsored.sum: Removes the prohibition on patient participation in multiple transplant programs in New York state.

sponsored.sum: Extends the imposition of additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes by Erie county to November 30, 2027.

sponsored.sum: Relates to the medical use of cannabis; repeals controlled substances therapeutic research act.

sponsored.sum: Facilitates the marketing of any issue of serial bonds or notes of the city of Buffalo issued on or before June 30, 2026.

sponsored.sum: Clarifies that the department of corrections is not required to obtain and input into its electronic record-keeping applications any individual's otherwise uncollected former legal name or any alias; amends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating thereto.
